added_lines: Telephone: 01 - 4522251 ON THE DEATH OF THE BELOVED By John O'Donohue (1956-2008) Though we need to weep your loss, You dwell in that safe place in our hearts, Where no storm or night or pain can reach you. Your love was like the dawn Brightening over our lives Awakening beneath the dark A further adventure of colour. The sound of your voice Found for us A new music That brightened everything. Whatever you enfolded in your gaze Quickened in the joy of its being; You placed smiles like Ňowers On the altar of the heart. Your mind always sparkled With wonder at things. Though your days here were brief, Your spirit was live, awake, complete. We look towards each other no longer From the old distance of our names; Now you dwell inside the of breath, As close to us as we are to ourselves. Though we cannot see you with outward eyes, We know our soul's gaze is upon your face, Smiling back at us from within everything To which we bring our best reĮnement. Let us not look for you only in memory, Where we would grow lonely without you. You would want us to Įnd you in presence, Beside us when beauty brightens, When kindness glows And music echoes eternal tones. hen orchids brighten the earth, Darkest winter has turned to spring; May this dark grief Ňower with hope In every heart that loves you. May you continue to inspire us: To enter each day with a generous heart. To serve the call of courage and love Until we see your beautiful face again In that land where there is no more separation, Where all tears will be wiped from our mind, And where we will never lose you again. ————————————————————— - PLEASE TAKE THIS HOME WITH YOU AS YOU LEAVE Killinard en Parish Sacred Heart Chur ch We would like to send our Condolences to the family and friends Of the late Caroline Cleary Beloved wife of Liam Whose funeral took place on Thursday November 19th. Share Appeal Sunday –November 7/8, 2026 The annual Share Appeal for the Archdiocese of Dublin takes place at all Sunday Masses this weekend.

The Share Fund plays a vital role across our diocese by providing essential pastoral services, administrative support, and resources for parishes; offering financial assistance and grants to lower-income and developing parishes in the archdiocese, and supporting central diocesan initiatives that serve our wider faith community.
We are deeply grateful for your continued generosity, loyalty, and support to the collections in our church.

RED WEDNESDAY takes place on 18 November 2026. More Christians have been killed because of their faith in Christ in the last century than the previous 1,900 years of Christian history.
This Wednesday, our Church will be lit up in red to remember our Christian martyrs.
Join us in standing with them in prayerful solidarity.
HYMNS FOR MASS Christ be beside me, Christ be before me, Christ be behind me.
King of my heart. Christ be within me, Christ be below me, Christ be above me, never to part.
Christ on my right hand, Christ on my left hand, Christ all round me, shield in the strife.
Christ in my sleeping, Christ in my sitting, Christ in my rising, light of my life.
Recessional Hymn Let’s all join together in Communion sweet, Walk, walk, in the light.
And love one another’til the Saviour we meet, Walk, walk, in the light.
Walk in the light, walk in the light, Walk in the light, walk in the light of the Lord.
Jesus died on Calvary, Walk, walk, in the light.
To save the lost like you and me, Walk, walk, in the light.
